title: Three Generations of Women, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of three women from different generations, likely a daughter, mother, and grandmother, taken during the early 1940s. The younger woman on the left wears a classic WWII-era tailored skirt suit with structured shoulders and victory-curl styled hair. The older women wear elegant hats, long coats, and scarves suitable for cooler weather. The photofinishing stamp 'R291' appears on the top reverse.
